svg.title: Unit architecture v2 (iteration 2)
svg.text: Filler unit — one FORTE resource, generated from units/filler.yaml
counts active skills; stays in Execute
only the ones a unit needs
Local channels loc[…]: shared signals without wiring
each an OPC UA object: Start(Session, params) · Stop · Abort · Reset → [Accepted, ErrorID] at once; State, Result, parameters published
internal instances, no OPC UA methods
Stop and Abort pass on to the running child
drives the down/up valves; one skill at a time
Dashed grey lines: local channels, not drawn as IEC 61499 connections in the IDE
